{"schema":"subagent-report/v1","task_id":"harness-version-drift","profile":"coder","findings":[{"id":"F1","text":"The script's loaded_contract_version almost certainly comes from a contract file bundled inside the repo (e.g. a checked-in AGENTS.md or template it ships with), not from the live session file at ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md. It is comparing spec_version (0.5.2) against its own bundled copy (0.5.2), so drift is trivially empty.","layer":"L1"},{"id":"F2","text":"installed_version: null and git_sha: null mean the script never probed the actually installed/active session environment. The drift check therefore has no third reference point; two identical bundled values are compared and the real 0.3.3 session contract is outside the comparison scope entirely.","layer":"L1"},{"id":"F3","text":"Nulls are treated as 'no drift' instead of 'unknown'. A drift array of [] with null provenance fields is a vacuous pass, not a verified alignment — the script should emit an explicit 'unknown/not-instrumented' status or a drift entry when it cannot read installed_version or git_sha.","layer":"L2"},{"id":"F4","text":"Remediation step 1: change the script to read the session contract at ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md (configurable via env var or --contract-path) as the loaded_contract_version source, and treat a missing/unreadable file as a hard failure.","layer":"L1"},{"id":"F5","text":"Remediation step 2: treat null installed_version or null git_sha as drift entries (e.g. {type: 'unknown-provenance'}) or exit non-zero, so a vacuous alignment can never be reported as success.","layer":"L1"},{"id":"F6","text":"Remediation step 3: reconcile the actual versions. Back up ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md, then either update the session contract to 0.5.2 (copy/symlink the repo contract) if the session runtime supports it, or pin spec_version back to 0.3.3 until the session can be upgraded. Do not leave spec and session on divergent majors/minors.","layer":"L2"},{"id":"F7","text":"Remediation step 4: add a CI/preflight check that hashes both the repo contract and the deployed session contract and fails on version or hash mismatch, so this class of false-positive cannot recur silently.","layer":"L3"},{"id":"F8","text":"Remediation step 5: re-run scripts/harness_version.py --json after the fix and verify it now reports the 0.5.2 vs 0.3.3 mismatch (or clean alignment after the contract update), with non-null installed_version and git_sha.","layer":"L4"}],"evidence":[{"id":"E1","kind":"console_output","text":"{\"spec_version\": \"0.5.2\", \"loaded_contract_version\": \"0.5.2\", \"installed_version\": null, \"git_sha\": null, \"drift\": []}"},{"id":"E2","kind":"file_inspection","text":"~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md reports session contract v0.3.3"}],"confidence_cap":0.7,"gaps":["Script source (scripts/harness_version.py) not inspected; the exact source of loaded_contract_version is inferred from the null fields and empty drift, not confirmed.","Unknown whether ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md is generated per-session or persistent, which affects whether step 3 should be a copy, symlink, or regeneration."],"recommendation":"Fix the script's source of truth first (F4) and make null provenance a failure (F5), then reconcile the 0.3.3 session contract with the 0.5.2 spec (F6), guard with CI (F7), and verify with a re-run (F8). Until F4/F5 land, treat any 'drift: []' output from this script as unverified."}
